# Allow all crawlers full access by default.
User-agent: *
Allow: /

# Block AI/LLM training bots from scraping site content.
# This helps protect your proprietary content from being used in
# large language models without permission.

# Google's AI models (e.g., for Vertex AI)
User-agent: Google-Extended
Disallow: /

# OpenAI's crawler (for models like GPT-4)
User-agent: GPTBot
Disallow: /

# Common Crawl (large public web dataset)
User-agent: CCBot
Disallow: /

# Perplexity AI's crawler
User-agent: PerplexityBot
Disallow: /

# Location of sitemap file
Sitemap: https://rigcraft-chi.vercel.app/sitemap.xml
